Maya K: Quick sweep across regions (us-east1 / eu-west1 / ap-south1) comparing H100 vs A100 for red-7b and red-13b quantized variants. TL;DR: H100 gives ~1.8-2.0x decode tokens/sec for 7B q8, ~1.4x for 13B q8. Costs per 1M tokens (generation only) roughly $0.65 (H100, 7B q8) vs $1.10 (A100, 7B q8) in our pricing. Full numbers + commands below.

Maya K: ```
Model | GPU | Region | prefill p50 (ms) | decode p50 (ms/token) | tokens/sec | $/1M gen
red-7b-q8   | H100 | us-east1   | 110  | 8.2  | 122 | $0.65
red-7b-q8   | A100 | us-east1   | 130  | 15.6 | 64  | $1.10
red-13b-q8  | H100 | us-east1   | 220  | 12.1 | 83  | $1.25
red-13b-q8  | A100 | us-east1   | 260  | 17.0 | 60  | $1.70
red-7b-q4x4 | H100 | eu-west1   | 120  | 9.5  | 105 | $0.58
red-13b-q4x4| A100 | ap-south1  | 280  | 19.8 | 50  | $1.90
```

Maya K: Notes: single-token decode p50 measured with synthetic 256-token context, batch=1, KV cold. Runs use runtime v0.12.3 with kernel selection ON. Pricing = cloud SKU + runtime overhead (in-region). Region differences primarily due to SKU/availability and memory fragmentation.

perf-bot: Dashboard uploaded: https://dash.redwood.internal/bench/2791234567  :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Dmitri V: nice. batch size?

Maya K: batch=1 for those. We also ran batch=2 for A100 -> ~1.4x tokens/sec but p95 latency increased ~22% (tradeoff for throughput). For H100 batch2 gives smaller p95 impact.

Sarah L: any quality diffs for q4x4 on 13B? last bring-up flagged hallucination increase.

Maya K: good call. On our SQuAD/QA slice q4x4 13B showed -2.3% exact-match vs q8; common failure is numeric precision in table parsing. For chat-style prompts we saw minor style shifts but no widespread hallucination spike.

Anika: which kernels ended up being chosen? did we see fallbacks on A100 in ap-south?

Maya K: default selector picked `fast-attn-v2` on H100, A100 used `tensor-ff` + memory-tiling kernels. We did see kernel fallback events in ap-south1 on A100 when the slab allocator was fragmented. Repro command (trace kernels):

```
rbench run --model red-7b-q8 --gpu a100 --region ap-south1 --batch 1 --trace kernels --repeat 200
```

Maya K: trace showed ~0.7% requests that hit fallback path -> +0.8ms per-token for those requests.

Leo: observed big cold KV p95 in asia for H100, looked like ingress->localstore pull. After enabling local prefix cache p95 dropped ~28%.

Dmitri V: cost/capacity question — if we move 7B to q4x4 on H100 what's the rough delta?

Maya K: measured 7B q4x4 on H100: ~140 tokens/sec, $/1M gen ~ $0.44 (region dependent). Quality checks on general chat are neutral; targeted QA showed tiny diffs.

Anika: suggestion — try forcing `kernel=warp-ll` for a sample run on A100 to avoid fallback, might smooth p95. Also try `--slab-defrag` in runtime v0.12.3 which reduced fallback by 80% in our lab runs.

Maya K: will run those. Uploading CSV of raw runs to the bench bucket (no link in thread). Planning: 1) kernel-forcing sweep (A100 ap-south), 2) q4x4 regress eval on wider eval set, 3) burst sizing test (multi-qps) for both SKUs.

perf-bot: Summary card: tokens/sec + $/1M attached to dashboard. Re-run job id=2791234567 to reproduce. :white_check_mark:

Leo: cool — ping me when kernel-forcing results are up, I'll check infra-side slab tuning.

Maya K: thanks all, will post updates and a short doc with recommended SKU/quantization per workload tomorrow.
